history.title: Garments with a story
history.text1: I work with second-hand garments that become a starting point once again. Each piece is selected, transformed and reimagined to create something new while preserving part of the story it carries.
history.text2: A garment does not end when it stops being worn. Sometimes, it is simply waiting for a new form.

about.title: Who is behind it?
about.intro1: I’m Aroa, the designer and creator behind this brand.
about.intro2: From Seville, I develop this project as a way of exploring my own understanding of fashion: working with what already exists and discovering all the possibilities it can hold.
about.intro3: My interest in fashion has always been connected to creating, transforming and experimenting.
about.intro4: Aroa López Sevilla was born from the desire to do things in a more personal way and to build a distinct identity through each creation.
about.project1: This project is based on transforming second-hand garments.
about.project2: I select pieces that already have a story and work with them to give them a new identity.
about.project3: It is not simply about reusing a garment, but about imagining what it could become. Changing its shape, combining materials, altering details or even completely transforming its purpose.
about.project4: The result is a collection of creations that preserve part of their past while beginning a new chapter.
about.manifesto: “Every piece begins with a search. Then comes the process of trying, unpicking, cutting, sewing and rebuilding. I do not always follow a defined path; often, it is the garment itself that shows where it can go.”

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.responsibleText: The data controller responsible for the personal data collected through this website is Aroa López Sevilla. Email: aroalopezsevilla@gmail.com.
privacy.dataText: This website may collect your email address when you subscribe to the newsletter, as well as your first name, last name, email address, subject and message when you use the contact form.
privacy.purposeText: Newsletter data is used to manage your subscription and send you news, new pieces, launches and other communications related to Aroa López Sevilla. Contact form data is used to respond to your enquiries and requests.
privacy.legalText: The legal basis for sending the newsletter is your consent, given when you subscribe. The legal basis for responding to contact form enquiries is the management of your request.
privacy.providersText: Brevo is used to manage the newsletter. FormSubmit is used to manage contact form submissions. These providers may process personal data necessary to provide their services.
privacy.retentionText: Newsletter data will be retained while you remain subscribed or until you request its deletion or withdraw your consent. Contact form data will be retained for as long as necessary to manage the enquiry and, where applicable, for the legally required periods.
privacy.unsubscribeText: You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time by using the unsubscribe link included in communications or by contacting aroalopezsevilla@gmail.com.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access, rectification, deletion, restriction, objection and portability of your data where applicable, as well as withdraw your consent. To exercise your rights, contact aroalopezsevilla@gmail.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency.
privacy.securityText: Technical and organisational measures are applied to protect personal data against loss, alteration, unauthorised access and other risks associated with processing.
privacy.changesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated when necessary to reflect legal, technical or service changes affecting the website. The current version will always be published on this page.
